lines.t: Do we have enough chairs for the training?
Almost all the chairs are in the meeting room. A few are in the office.
How much equipment do we need?
Not much. Each person needs a laptop, but we only need one projector.
Are both of the trainers coming?
No. Neither of them is available this morning. They can join us after lunch.
Okay. Most of our coworkers can start at two.
Good. We have fewer activities this time, so we need less time.
Not yet. Some of them have questions. I’ll send another message.
